name: keyloom-desktop
description: A local encrypted vault with controlled agent writes and ciphertext-only Git backups.

scripts.typecheck:sdk: tsc --ignoreConfig --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --noCheck --moduleResolution bundler --module esnext --target esnext --skipLibCheck --types bun --rootDir node_modules/electrobun/dist/api --outDir .sdk-types node_modules/electrobun/dist/api/bun/core/BrowserWindow.ts node_modules/electrobun/dist/api/bun/core/Utils.ts node_modules/electrobun/dist/api/bun/core/Paths.ts node_modules/electrobun/dist/api/bun/ElectrobunConfig.ts node_modules/electrobun/dist/api/browser/index.ts
scripts.build: bun run typecheck && bun run build:view && bun run build:backend && electrobun build
scripts.build:release: bun run typecheck && bun run build:view && bun run build:backend && electrobun build --env=stable && bun run build:portable
